title: How to Discover and Understand Your Work Style | Self-Awareness = Key to Career Growth
description:
Having a deep understanding of who you are and how others perceive you can help you figure out what you want to do and where you want to go.

The more we can bring our whole and authentic selves to work with an understanding of what matters to us, what energizes us, and what drains us, the higher likelihood we will be successful. The first step in career growth is having that self-awareness and understanding of which environments energize us and which we naturally gravitate toward. The more we can do that, the higher our chances of us being successful in our work.

In this class, we’ll go over the following: 

00:00 Introduction
00:55  How to build self-awareness (including some of the frameworks we've leveraged)
03:58 What's a work style?
06:25 Teal's Work Style framework
07:17 What's your primary style?
08:36 How the 4 parts of your Work Style fit together
14:48 Traits of a Primary 1
15:46 Traits of a Primary 2
16:04 Traits of a Primary 3
16:36 Traits of a Primary 4
17:04 Understanding your Work Style sequence
19:29 Your Work Style summary & career insights
21:53 How do others see you?
24:13 Wrapping up & conclusion
